0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.definition: The doubt a person is given about their own memory, until they check themselves instead of the facts.
0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.gloss: The doubt a person is given about their own memory, until they check themselves instead of the facts.

0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.definition: 他者が人の記憶に対する疑念をあおり、事実を確認する前に自分の記憶を疑わせることをいう。人為的にすり込まれた疑念を指す。
0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.gloss: 自分の記憶を疑わせることを、人為的に stirred Anyway.

0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.definition: 상대가 자신의 기억을 의심하도록 유도해, 사실을 확인하기보다 자기 기억을 다시 점검하게 만드는 의심을 뜻한다.
0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.gloss: 자신의 기억에 대한 의심을 만들어 내는 상태다.

0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.definition: Incerteza fabricada em uma pessoa para que ela passe a questionar sua própria memória e a verificar a si mesma, em vez de conferir os fatos registrados.
0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.gloss: Dúvida induzida sobre a própria memória, em vez de sobre os fatos.

0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.definition: Ragu-raguan yang diberikan kepada seseorang tentang ingatannya sendiri, sampai ia memeriksa dirinya sendiri alih-alih fakta. Yang diperiksa adalah ingatannya, bukan catatan yang ada.
0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.gloss: Ragu-raguan yang diberikan kepada seseorang tentang ingatannya sendiri, sampai ia memeriksa dirinya sendiri alih-alih fakta.

0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.definition: ความสงสัยเกี่ยวกับความทรงจำที่ถูกบ่มให้จนบุคคลนั้นตรวจสอบความทรงจำของตนแทนที่จะตรวจสอบข้อเท็จจริง
0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.gloss: ความสงสัยที่ถูกสร้างขึ้นให้ต่อความทรงจำของตนเอง

0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.definition: Başka birinin, kişinin kendi hatırladıklarını sorgulamasına yol açan yapay kuşku. Bu durumda kişi gerçekleri değil kendi belleğini denetlemeye yönelir.
0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.gloss: Bir kişinin kendi belleğine güvenmeye başlayana dek ona aşılan kuşku.

0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.translation: Sonuç yapay kuşku oldu: adam kendi belleğini, kayıt yerine kendi kendine denetlemeye başladı.
ผลที่เกิดขึ้นคือความสงสัยที่ถูกสร้างขึ้น เขาเริ่มตรวจสอบความทรงจำของตนเองแทนที่จะดูบันทึก
Hasilnya adalah keraguan yang sengaja: ia mulai memeriksa ingatannya sendiri, bukan catatan yang ada.
O resultado foi uma dúvida fabricada: ele começou a verificar a própria memória em vez do registro.
결과는 인위적 의심이었다. 그는 사실을 살펴보기 전에 자기 기억을 확인하기 시작했다.
その結果は記憶の doubtであった。彼は記録ではなく自分の記憶を確認し始めた。

0056c33a9f096da8d328f29a690ce109f45bd6c0.text: The result was manufactured doubt: he began to check his own memory instead of the record.

00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.definition: How many potential partners a person can actually meet, given where they live and how their life is arranged.
00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.gloss: How many potential partners a person can actually meet, given where they live and how their life is arranged.

00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.definition: その人の居住地や生活環境によって、出会える交際候補者が何人いるか。候補者が少ない状態を「市場が薄い」と呼ぶ。
00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.gloss: 住まいや生活環境によって、実際に会える交際候補者が何人いるか。

00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.definition: 거주지와 생활 방식 때문에 한 사람이 실제로 만날 수 있는 잠재 상대의 수이다. 단순히 지역에 사는 사람 수를 뜻하지 않는다.
00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.gloss: 생활 환경상 실제로 만날 수 있는 잠재 상대의 수.

00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.definition: Número de parceiros potenciais que uma pessoa consegue encontrar efetivamente, considerando o lugar onde mora e a forma como conduz a vida. É sempre menor do que o número teórico de pessoas disponíveis.
00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.gloss: Quantos parceiros potenciais uma pessoa encontra de fato, dados onde mora e como organiza a vida.

00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.definition: Ketebalan pasar menunjukkan berapa banyak calon pasangan yang dapat ditemui berdasarkan lokasi, lingkaran sosial, dan cara hidup seseorang. Ukurannya bukan jumlah seluruh penduduk di suatu tempat.
00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.gloss: Ketebalan pasar adalah banyaknya calon pasangan yang benar-benar dapat ditemui seseorang.

00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.definition: หมายถึงจำนวนผู้คนที่แต่ละฝ่ายมีโอกาสพบจริง โดยขึ้นอยู่กับที่อยู่และการจัดชีวิต ตลาดที่บางจึงหมายถึงมีคู่ที่เลือกได้น้อย ไม่ใช่มีคนน้อยทั้งโลก
00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.gloss: จำนวนคู่ที่มีโอกาสพบจริงตามสภาพแวดล้อมและการจัดชีวิตของแต่ละคน

00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.definition: Bir kişinin sosyal çevresinde erişebildiği potansiyel eşlerin sayısıdır; genel nüfus veya tanıdıkların toplamı değildir.
00b4b489f742ddffd4ccbb58e214ac1474c84157.gloss: Bir kişinin yaşadığı yerde ve yaşam düzenine göre tanışabileceği potansiyel eş sayısı.

00bddb36a62f5719e4711f0209a8cfffdda5f6c9.definition: 자발적으로 혼자 있는 것으로, 외로움처럼 상실감이나 괴로움이 따르지 않는다. 쓸쓸함이나 고립감을 뜻하지는 않는다.

00bddb36a62f5719e4711f0209a8cfffdda5f6c9.definition: Estado de estar sozinho por escolha, sem necessariamente envolver sofrimento ou sensação de abandono. É diferente do sentimento de solidão provocado pela ausência de outras pessoas.
00bddb36a62f5719e4711f0209a8cfffdda5f6c9.gloss: Estar sozinho por escolha, sem perda ou sofrimento, ao contrário do sentimento de solidão causado pela ausência de outras pessoas.

00bddb36a62f5719e4711f0209a8cfffdda5f6c9.gloss: Kesendirian adalah keadaan sendirian yang dipilih dengan sengaja.
